questions.text: दी गई आकृति में केन्द्र O वाले वृत्त पर एक बाह्य बिंदु P से यदि PA तथा PB स्पर्श-रेखाएँ खींची गई हैं जिनके बीच का कोण 80° है, तो ∠POA की माप है:
questions.text_english: If tangents PA and PB drawn from an external point P to the circle with centre O are inclined to each other at an angle of 80° as shown in the given figure, then the measure of ∠POA is:
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. An external point P from which two tangents PA and PB are drawn. The angle APB = 80° is marked at P. O is to the right of P.
questions.solution: Since PA and PB are tangents from external point P, ∠APB = 80°. In quadrilateral PAOB, ∠PAO = ∠PBO = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent). So ∠AOB = 360° − 90° − 90° − 80° = 100°. Since OA = OB (radii), triangle OAB is isosceles, and by symmetry OP bisects ∠AOB. Also OP bisects ∠APB. In triangle OAP, ∠OAP = 90°, so ∠POA = 90° − ∠APO = 90° − 40° = 50°. Hence ∠POA = 50°. Option B is correct. Option A (40°) is ∠APO, not ∠POA. Option C and D are incorrect as they don't follow from the angle relationships.

questions.text_english: If the mean of 2, 9, x+6, 2x+3, 5, 10, 5 is 7, then the value of x is:
questions.solution: Mean = Sum of observations / Number of observations. Here, sum = 2 + 9 + (x+6) + (2x+3) + 5 + 10 + 5 = 40 + 3x. Number of observations = 7. So (40 + 3x)/7 = 7, which gives 40 + 3x = 49, so 3x = 9, thus x = 3. Option D is correct. Options A, B, and C give incorrect sums that do not yield a mean of 7.

questions.text: यदि दो घनों के आयतनों में 8 : 125 का अनुपात है, तो उनके पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफलों में अनुपात है:
questions.text_english: If the volumes of two cubes are in the ratio 8 : 125, then the ratio of their surface areas is:
questions.solution: Let the sides of the two cubes be a and b. Volume ratio = a³ : b³ = 8 : 125, so a/b = 2/5. Surface area of a cube = 6a². So the ratio of surface areas = 6a² : 6b² = a² : b² = (2)² : (5)² = 4 : 25. Option B is correct. Option A is the volume ratio itself, C is the side ratio, and D is incorrect.

questions.text: △PQR के दो शीर्ष P(−1, 5) तथा Q(5, 2) हैं। रेखाखण्ड PQ को 2 : 1 के अनुपात में बाँटने वाले बिंदु के निर्देशांक हैं:
questions.text_english: Two of the vertices of △PQR are P(−1, 5) and Q(5, 2). The coordinates of a point which divides PQ in the ratio 2 : 1 are:
questions.solution: Using the section formula, the point dividing P(−1, 5) and Q(5, 2) in ratio 2:1 is: x = (2×5 + 1×(−1))/(2+1) = (10−1)/3 = 9/3 = 3. y = (2×2 + 1×5)/(2+1) = (4+5)/3 = 9/3 = 3. So the point is (3, 3). Option C is correct. The other options result from incorrect application of the section formula.

questions.text: यदि sin 4θ = √3/2 है, तो θ/3 बराबर है:
questions.text_english: If sin 4θ = √3/2, then θ/3 equals:
questions.solution: sin 4θ = √3/2 implies 4θ = 60° (since sin 60° = √3/2). Therefore θ = 15°. Then θ/3 = 15°/3 = 5°. Option D is correct. Option C gives θ itself, not θ/3. Options A and B arise from incorrect calculations.

questions.text: बहुपद p(y) = 7y² − (11/3)y − 2/3 के शून्यक हैं:
questions.text_english: Zeroes of the polynomial p(y) = 7y² − (11/3)y − 2/3 are:
questions.solution: Multiply throughout by 3: 21y² − 11y − 2 = 0. Factorising: 21y² − 14y + 3y − 2 = 0, giving 7y(3y − 2) + 1(3y − 2) = 0, so (3y − 2)(7y + 1) = 0. Therefore y = 2/3 or y = −1/7. Option D is correct. The other options have incorrect signs or values for one or both zeroes.

questions.text: दो चरों वाले दो रैखिक समीकरणों का निकाय असंगत होगा, यदि ग्राफ पर बनी रेखाएँ:
questions.text_english: A system of two linear equations in two variables is inconsistent, if the lines in the graph are:

options.C: एक बिंदु पर प्रतिच्छेदी हों / intersecting at one point
options.D: समकोण पर प्रतिच्छेदी हों / intersecting at right angles

questions.solution: An inconsistent system has no solution, meaning the two lines never meet. Parallel lines never intersect, so there is no common point (solution). Option B is correct. Coincident lines (Option A) give infinitely many solutions. Intersecting lines (Options C and D) give exactly one solution — both are consistent systems.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: आयत AOBC के तीन शीर्ष A(0, 2), O(0, 0) तथा B(4, 0) हैं। इसके विकर्ण की लंबाई का वर्ग बराबर है:
questions.text_english: AOBC is a rectangle whose three vertices are A(0, 2), O(0, 0) and B(4, 0). The square of the length of its diagonal is equal to:
questions.solution: The diagonal of rectangle AOBC connects A(0,2) and B(4,0) (or O(0,0) and C). Using distance formula: AB² = (4−0)² + (0−2)² = 16 + 4 = 20. So the square of the diagonal length is 20. Option B is correct. Option C (16) is only the horizontal distance squared, and Option A (36) is incorrect.

questions.text: यदि 4, 6, 8 का ल.स. (LCM) x है, 3, 5, 7 का ल.स. y है तथा x और y का ल.स. p है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?
questions.text_english: If x is the LCM of 4, 6, 8 and y is the LCM of 3, 5, 7 and p is the LCM of x and y, then which of the following is true?

questions.text: एक पासे को एक बार फेंका जाता है। ऐसी संख्या के आने की प्रायिकता जो 36 का गुणनखण्ड न हो, है:
questions.text_english: A die is thrown once. The probability of getting a number which is not a factor of 36, is:
questions.solution: Factors of 36 among {1,2,3,4,5,6}: 36 = 1×36 = 2×18 = 3×12 = 4×9 = 6×6. So factors of 36 that appear on a die are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 — that is 5 numbers. Only 5 is NOT a factor of 36. So the number of favourable outcomes = 1, and probability = 1/6. Option C is correct. Option A (1/2) would be incorrect as it implies 3 non-factors.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △ABC में, AD ⊥ BC तथा ∠BAC = 90° है। यदि BC = 16 cm तथा DC = 4 cm है, तो x का मान है:
questions.text_english: In the given figure, in △ABC, AD ⊥ BC and ∠BAC = 90°. If BC = 16 cm and DC = 4 cm, then the value of x is:
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with ∠BAC = 90°. AD is perpendicular to BC. D is on BC. BC = 16 cm, DC = 4 cm are marked. x is the length of AC.
questions.solution: In △ABC, ∠BAC = 90° and AD ⊥ BC. By the geometric mean relation, AC² = DC × BC. Here DC = 4 cm and BC = 16 cm. So AC² = 4 × 16 = 64, giving AC = 8 cm. Therefore x = 8 cm. Option C is correct. This uses the property that in a right triangle, the altitude from the right angle to the hypotenuse creates similar triangles.

questions.text: यदि α तथा β, बहुपद p(x) = x² − ax − b के शून्यक हैं, तो (α + β + αβ) बराबर है:
questions.text_english: If α and β are the zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = x² − ax − b, then the value of (α + β + αβ) is equal to:
questions.solution: For p(x) = x² − ax − b, by Vieta's formulas: α + β = a (sum of zeroes = −coefficient of x / coefficient of x²= −(−a)/1 = a) and αβ = −b (product of zeroes = constant term / coefficient of x² = −b/1 = −b). Therefore α + β + αβ = a + (−b) = a − b. Option C is correct.

questions.text: cosθ / √(1 − cos²θ) बराबर है:
questions.text_english: cosθ / √(1 − cos²θ) is equal to:
questions.solution: We know that 1 − cos²θ = sin²θ, so √(1 − cos²θ) = sinθ. Therefore cosθ / √(1 − cos²θ) = cosθ / sinθ = cot θ. Option A is correct. Option D (tan θ) = sinθ/cosθ which is the reciprocal. Options B and C do not simplify from this expression correctly.

questions.text: द्विघात समीकरण bx² + ax + c = 0; b ≠ 0 का विविक्तकर है:
questions.text_english: The discriminant of the quadratic equation bx² + ax + c = 0; b ≠ 0 is given by:
questions.solution: For a general quadratic equation Ax² + Bx + C = 0, the discriminant is B² − 4AC. Here the equation is bx² + ax + c = 0, so A = b, B = a, C = c. Therefore discriminant = a² − 4bc. Option D is correct. Option A confuses the roles of a and b by using standard notation incorrectly. Options B and C are square roots, not the discriminant itself.

questions.text: यदि बिंदुओं (a, 4) तथा (2, 2b) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखण्ड का मध्य-बिंदु (2, 6) है, तो (a + b) का मान है:
questions.text_english: If the mid-point of the line segment joining the points (a, 4) and (2, 2b) is (2, 6), then the value of (a + b) is given by:
questions.solution: Midpoint formula: ((a+2)/2, (4+2b)/2) = (2, 6). From x-coordinate: (a+2)/2 = 2, so a+2 = 4, thus a = 2. From y-coordinate: (4+2b)/2 = 6, so 4+2b = 12, thus 2b = 8, b = 4. Therefore a + b = 2 + 4 = 6. Wait — that gives 6, which is Option A. Let me recheck: a = 2, b = 4, a+b = 6. Option A is correct.

questions.text: यदि 36 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के एक त्रिज्यखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल 54π cm² है, तो इस त्रिज्यखण्ड के संगत चाप की लंबाई है:
questions.text_english: If the area of a sector of circle of radius 36 cm is 54π cm², then the length of the corresponding arc of the sector is:
questions.solution: Area of sector = (1/2) × r × l, where l is arc length. So 54π = (1/2) × 36 × l, giving 54π = 18l, thus l = 3π cm. Option D is correct. Alternatively, area = (θ/360°) × πr², so θ/360° = 54π/(π×36²) = 54/1296 = 1/24, and arc length = (θ/360°) × 2πr = (1/24) × 2π × 36 = 3π cm.
questions.topic: Arc Length and Area of Sector

questions.text: नीचे दी गई आकृति में दो त्रिभुजों LMN तथा ABC के माप दिए गए हैं। भुजा AC की लंबाई है:
questions.text_english: The measurements of △LMN and △ABC are shown in the figure given below. The length of side AC is:
questions.image_description: Two triangles LMN and ABC. In triangle LMN: LM = 45 cm, LN = 72 cm, MN = 63 cm, angle at M = 130°, angle at N = 28°. In triangle ABC: AB = 5 cm, angle at A = 22°, angle at B = 130°. AC = ? is to be found.
questions.solution: In △LMN and △ABC: ∠M = ∠B = 130°. ∠N = 28°, so ∠L = 180°−130°−28° = 22° = ∠A. Thus △LMN ~ △ABC (AA similarity). So AB/LM = AC/LN = BC/MN. AB/LM = 5/45 = 1/9. Therefore AC = LN/9 = 72/9 = 8 cm. Wait: AC corresponds to LN. So AC = 72 × (5/45) = 72/9 = 8 cm. That gives option C. Checking: ∠A = 22° corresponds to ∠L = 22°, ∠B = 130° corresponds to ∠M = 130°. So AB/LM = BC/MN = AC/LN. AC = LN × (AB/LM) = 72 × (5/45) = 8 cm. Option C is correct.

questions.text: यदि दो त्रिभुजों △DEF तथा △PQR में, ∠D = ∠Q तथा ∠R = ∠E है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही नहीं है?
questions.text_english: If in two triangles △DEF and △PQR, ∠D = ∠Q and ∠R = ∠E, then which of the following is not true?
questions.solution: Given ∠D = ∠Q and ∠R = ∠E, the third angles are also equal: ∠F = ∠P. So △DEF ~ △QPR (by AA). The correspondence is D↔Q, E↔P... wait: ∠D = ∠Q, ∠E = ∠R, ∠F = ∠P. So the similarity is △DEF ~ △QRP. Thus DE/QR = EF/RP = DF/QP. Checking option D: DE/PQ — here PQ corresponds to QR in our mapping, so DE/PQ would be incorrect. Option D states DE/PQ = EF/RP, which mixes the correspondence. The correct ratio should be DE/QR = EF/RP. Hence Option D is not true.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): एक बाह्य बिंदु से वृत्त पर खींची गई दो स्पर्श-रेखाएँ, वृत्त के केन्द्र पर समान कोण अन्तरित करती हैं।
तर्क (R): एक वृत्त के परिगत समांतर चतुर्भुज, एक समचतुर्भुज होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If two tangents are drawn to a circle from an external point, then they subtend equal angles at the centre of the circle.
Reason (R): A parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही उत्तर चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: tangents from an external point to a circle are equal in length, and the triangles formed are congruent (RHS), so the angles subtended at the centre are equal. Reason (R) is also true: in a parallelogram circumscribing a circle, tangents from each vertex are equal, which forces all sides to be equal, making it a rhombus. However, Reason (R) is a property of circumscribed parallelograms and does not directly explain why tangents subtend equal angles at the centre. So both are true but R is not the correct explanation of A. Option B is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): दीवार के साथ लगी हुई एक सीढ़ी के पाद की दीवार से क्षैतिज दूरी 6 m है। यदि यह दीवार पर 8 m ऊँचाई तक पहुँचती है, तो सीढ़ी की लंबाई 10 m है।
तर्क (R): सीढ़ी, भूमि से 60° का कोण बनाती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): A ladder leaning against a wall, stands at a horizontal distance of 6 m from the wall. If the height of the wall up to which the ladder reaches is 8 m, then the length of the ladder is 10 m.
Reason (R): The ladder makes an angle of 60° with the ground.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही उत्तर चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: by Pythagoras theorem, ladder length = √(6² + 8²) = √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10 m. Reason (R) is false: the angle the ladder makes with the ground is θ where tan θ = 8/6 = 4/3, so θ = arctan(4/3) ≈ 53.13°, not 60°. Since Assertion is true but Reason is false, Option C is correct.

questions.text:
(क) यदि बहुपद p(x) = (p + 1) x² + (2p + 3) x + (3p + 4) के शून्यकों का योगफल −1 है, तो 'p' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) यदि α तथा β बहुपद p(x) = x² − 2x − 1 के शून्यक हैं, तो 1/(2α) + 1/(2β) + 3αβ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If the sum of the zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = (p + 1) x² + (2p + 3) x + (3p + 4) is −1, then find the value of 'p'.
OR
(b) If α and β are zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = x² − 2x − 1, then find the value of 1/(2α) + 1/(2β) + 3αβ.

sub_questions.text: यदि बहुपद p(x) = (p + 1) x² + (2p + 3) x + (3p + 4) के शून्यकों का योगफल −1 है, तो 'p' का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If the sum of the zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = (p + 1) x² + (2p + 3) x + (3p + 4) is −1, then find the value of 'p'.
sub_questions.solution: For polynomial p(x) = (p+1)x² + (2p+3)x + (3p+4), sum of zeroes = −(2p+3)/(p+1). Setting this equal to −1: −(2p+3)/(p+1) = −1, so 2p+3 = p+1, giving p = 1−3 = −2. Therefore p = −2.

sub_questions.text: यदि α तथा β बहुपद p(x) = x² − 2x − 1 के शून्यक हैं, तो 1/(2α) + 1/(2β) + 3αβ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If α and β are zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = x² − 2x − 1, then find the value of 1/(2α) + 1/(2β) + 3αβ.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives. See sub-questions (a) and (b) for detailed solutions.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि वृत्त के किसी व्यास के सिरों पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखाएँ परस्पर समांतर होती हैं।
questions.text_english: Prove that the tangents drawn at the ends of a diameter of a circle are parallel.

key_points: Radius ⊥ tangent at point of contact
Both tangents make 90° with the diameter
Co-interior angles sum to 180°, so tangents are parallel

questions.solution: Let AB be a diameter of a circle with centre O. Let PQ be the tangent at A and RS be the tangent at B. Since the radius OA is perpendicular to tangent PQ at point A, we have ∠OAP = ∠OAQ = 90°. Similarly, since OB is perpendicular to RS at B, ∠OBR = ∠OBS = 90°. Now, ∠OAP + ∠OBR = 90° + 90° = 180°. These are co-interior angles formed by transversal AB with lines PQ and RS. Since co-interior angles sum to 180°, PQ ∥ RS. Hence the tangents at the ends of a diameter are parallel.

questions.text:
(क) वह छोटी से छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 644 तथा 462 दोनों से विभाजित हो।
अथवा
(ख) दो संख्याएँ 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा उनका म.स. (HCF) 11 है। इन संख्याओं का ल.स. (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the smallest number which is divisible by both 644 and 462.
OR
(b) Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 5 and their HCF is 11. Find the LCM of these numbers.

sub_questions.text: वह छोटी से छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 644 तथा 462 दोनों से विभाजित हो।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the smallest number which is divisible by both 644 and 462.
sub_questions.solution: The smallest number divisible by both 644 and 462 is their LCM. Using Euclid's algorithm: HCF(644, 462) = HCF(462, 182) = HCF(182, 98) = HCF(98, 84) = HCF(84, 14) = 14. Therefore LCM = 644 × 462 / 14 = 46 × 462 = 21252. Let me recalculate: 644/14 = 46, so LCM = 46 × 462 = 21252. The smallest number divisible by both 644 and 462 is 21252.

sub_questions.text: दो संख्याएँ 4 : 5 के अनुपात में हैं तथा उनका म.स. (HCF) 11 है। इन संख्याओं का ल.स. (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 5 and their HCF is 11. Find the LCM of these numbers.
sub_questions.solution: Let the two numbers be 4k and 5k. Since their HCF is 11, we have k = 11. So the numbers are 44 and 55. LCM × HCF = Product of the two numbers. LCM = (44 × 55) / 11 = 44 × 5 = 220. Therefore the LCM of the two numbers is 220.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives. See sub-questions (a) and (b) for detailed solutions.

questions.text: यदि 4k = tan² 60° − 2 cosec² 30° − 2 tan² 30° है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: If 4k = tan² 60° − 2 cosec² 30° − 2 tan² 30°, then find the value of k.
questions.solution: Using standard trigonometric values: tan 60° = √3, so tan² 60° = 3. cosec 30° = 2, so cosec² 30° = 4. tan 30° = 1/√3, so tan² 30° = 1/3. Substituting: 4k = 3 − 2(4) − 2(1/3) = 3 − 8 − 2/3 = −5 − 2/3 = −17/3. Therefore k = −17/12.

questions.text: एक निश्चित परीक्षा प्रश्न के सही उत्तर का अनुमान लगाने की प्रायिकता x/12 है। यदि इसी प्रश्न के सही उत्तर का अनुमान न लगा पाने की प्रायिकता 5/6 है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: The probability of guessing the correct answer of a certain test question is x/12. If the probability of not guessing the correct answer is 5/6, then find the value of x.
questions.solution: The sum of the probability of guessing the correct answer and the probability of not guessing the correct answer must equal 1. So x/12 + 5/6 = 1. Converting to a common denominator: x/12 + 10/12 = 1, giving (x + 10)/12 = 1, so x + 10 = 12, therefore x = 2.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि (4√2 + 5/3) एक अपरिमेय संख्या है, जबकि दिया गया है कि √2 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that (4√2 + 5/3) is an irrational number given that √2 is an irrational number.
questions.solution: Assume, for contradiction, that (4√2 + 5/3) is rational. Then there exist integers p and q (q ≠ 0) such that 4√2 + 5/3 = p/q. Rearranging: 4√2 = p/q − 5/3 = (3p − 5q)/(3q). Therefore √2 = (3p − 5q)/(12q). Since p, q are integers and q ≠ 0, the right-hand side is rational. This means √2 is rational. But this contradicts the given fact that √2 is irrational. Our assumption is false. Hence (4√2 + 5/3) is an irrational number.

questions.text:
यदि किसी जनसंख्या के 65% लोगों की आँखें काली हैं, 25% की आँखें भूरे रंग की हैं तथा शेष की नीले रंग की हैं, तो यादृच्छया चुने गए व्यक्ति की आँखों का रंग निम्नलिखित होने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
(क) नीले रंग की
(ख) भूरे या काले रंग की
questions.text_english:
If 65% of the population has black eyes, 25% have brown eyes and the remaining have blue eyes, what is the probability that a person selected at random has:
(a) blue eyes?
(b) brown or black eyes?

sub_questions.text: नीले रंग की
sub_questions.text_english: blue eyes?
sub_questions.solution: Percentage of people with blue eyes = 100% − 65% − 25% = 10%. So P(blue eyes) = 10/100 = 1/10.

sub_questions.text: भूरे या काले रंग की
sub_questions.text_english: brown or black eyes?
sub_questions.solution: Percentage with brown or black eyes = 25% + 65% = 90%. So P(brown or black eyes) = 90/100 = 9/10.

questions.solution: See sub-questions (a) and (b) for solutions.

questions.text: 10 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की एक जीवा, वृत्त के केन्द्र पर समकोण अन्तरित करती है। संगत लघु वृत्तखण्ड का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए। [π = 3·14 प्रयोग कीजिए]
questions.text_english: A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at the centre of the circle. Find the area of the corresponding minor segment. [Use π = 3·14]
questions.solution: Given radius r = 10 cm and central angle θ = 90°. Area of minor sector = (θ/360°) × πr² = (90/360) × 3.14 × 100 = (1/4) × 314 = 78.5 cm². Area of triangle formed by the two radii and chord = (1/2) × r² × sinθ = (1/2) × 100 × sin90° = 50 cm². Area of minor segment = Area of sector − Area of triangle = 78.5 − 50 = 28.5 cm².

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, PC बिंदु C पर वृत्त की स्पर्श-रेखा है तथा AOB व्यास है, जो बढ़ाने पर स्पर्श-रेखा को P पर मिलता है। यदि ∠PCA = 110° है, तो ∠CBA तथा ∠BCO ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PC is a tangent to the circle at C. AOB is the diameter which when extended meets the tangent at P. Find ∠CBA and ∠BCO, if ∠PCA = 110°.
questions.solution: Since PC is tangent at C and OC is radius, ∠OCP = 90°. So ∠OCA = ∠PCA − ∠PCO = 110° − 90° = 20°. Since OC = OA (radii), triangle OCA is isosceles, so ∠OAC = ∠OCA = 20°. In triangle OCA: ∠COA = 180° − 20° − 20° = 140°. Since AOB is a straight line, ∠COB = 180° − 140° = 40°. Triangle OCB is isosceles (OC = OB), so ∠OCB = ∠OBC = (180° − 40°)/2 = 70°. Therefore ∠BCO = 70°. Also, ∠CBA = ∠OBC = 70°. Wait — ∠CBA means angle at B in triangle ABC. Since ∠ACB = 90° (angle in semicircle) and ∠CAB = ∠OAC = 20°, ∠CBA = 90° − 20° = 70°. So ∠CBA = 70° and ∠BCO = 70°.

questions.text:
(क) सिद्ध कीजिए कि: √((secA−1)/(secA+1)) + √((secA+1)/(secA−1)) = 2 cosec A
अथवा
(ख) सिद्ध कीजिए कि: (1/cosA − cosA)(1/sinA − sinA) = 1/(tanA + cotA)
questions.text_english:
(a) Prove that: √((secA−1)/(secA+1)) + √((secA+1)/(secA−1)) = 2 cosec A
OR
(b) Prove that: (1/cosA − cosA)(1/sinA − sinA) = 1/(tanA + cotA)

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि: √((secA−1)/(secA+1)) + √((secA+1)/(secA−1)) = 2 cosec A
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that: √((secA−1)/(secA+1)) + √((secA+1)/(secA−1)) = 2 cosec A
sub_questions.solution: LHS = √((secA−1)/(secA+1)) + √((secA+1)/(secA−1)) = [(secA−1) + (secA+1)] / √((secA+1)(secA−1)) = 2 secA / √(sec²A−1) = 2 secA / √(tan²A) = 2 secA / tanA = 2 × (1/cosA) × (cosA/sinA) = 2/sinA = 2 cosec A = RHS. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि: (1/cosA − cosA)(1/sinA − sinA) = 1/(tanA + cotA)
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that: (1/cosA − cosA)(1/sinA − sinA) = 1/(tanA + cotA)
sub_questions.solution: LHS = (1/cosA − cosA)(1/sinA − sinA) = ((1−cos²A)/cosA) × ((1−sin²A)/sinA) = (sin²A/cosA) × (cos²A/sinA) = sinA cosA. RHS = 1/(tanA + cotA) = 1/(sinA/cosA + cosA/sinA) = 1/((sin²A + cos²A)/(sinA cosA)) = 1/(1/(sinA cosA)) = sinA cosA. Since LHS = RHS = sinA cosA, the identity is proved.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives. See sub-questions (a) and (b) for detailed proofs.

questions.text:
(क) यदि बिंदुओं A(3, 4) तथा B(k, 6) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखण्ड का मध्य-बिंदु P(x, y) है तथा x + y − 10 = 0 है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) बिंदुओं A(−2, 2) तथा B(2, 8) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखण्ड को चार समान भागों में बाँटने वाले बिंदुओं के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If the mid-point of the line segment joining the points A(3, 4) and B(k, 6) is P(x, y) and x + y − 10 = 0, find the value of k.
OR
(b) Find the coordinates of the points which divide the line segment joining A(−2, 2) and B(2, 8) into four equal parts.

sub_questions.text: यदि बिंदुओं A(3, 4) तथा B(k, 6) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखण्ड का मध्य-बिंदु P(x, y) है तथा x + y − 10 = 0 है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If the mid-point of the line segment joining the points A(3, 4) and B(k, 6) is P(x, y) and x + y − 10 = 0, find the value of k.

key_points: Substituting in x + y = 10 gives k = 7

sub_questions.solution: Midpoint P(x, y) of A(3,4) and B(k,6) is x = (3+k)/2 and y = (4+6)/2 = 5. Since x + y − 10 = 0, we have (3+k)/2 + 5 = 10, so (3+k)/2 = 5, giving 3+k = 10, hence k = 7.

sub_questions.text: बिंदुओं A(−2, 2) तथा B(2, 8) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखण्ड को चार समान भागों में बाँटने वाले बिंदुओं के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the coordinates of the points which divide the line segment joining A(−2, 2) and B(2, 8) into four equal parts.
sub_questions.solution: Let P1, P2, P3 divide AB into four equal parts. P2 is the midpoint: P2 = ((−2+2)/2, (2+8)/2) = (0, 5). P1 is the midpoint of A and P2: P1 = ((−2+0)/2, (2+5)/2) = (−1, 3.5). P3 is the midpoint of P2 and B: P3 = ((0+2)/2, (5+8)/2) = (1, 6.5). The three points dividing AB into four equal parts are (−1, 7/2), (0, 5), and (1, 13/2).

questions.text:
(क) 'n' पदों वाली एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी का nवाँ पद 4 तथा सार्व अंतर 2 है। यदि इसके 'n' पदों का योगफल −14 है, तो 'n' ज्ञात कीजिए। प्रथम 20 पदों का योगफल भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी के प्रथम छः पदों का योगफल 42 है। इसके 10वें तथा 30वें पदों का अनुपात 1 : 3 है। समांतर श्रेढ़ी का पहला तथा तेरहवाँ पद परिकलित कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) An AP consists of 'n' terms whose nth term is 4 and the common difference is 2. If the sum of 'n' terms of AP is −14, then find 'n'. Also, find the sum of the first 20 terms.
OR
(b) The sum of the first six terms of an arithmetic progression is 42. The ratio of the 10th term to the 30th term is 1 : 3. Calculate the first and the thirteenth terms of the AP.

sub_questions.text: 'n' पदों वाली एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी का nवाँ पद 4 तथा सार्व अंतर 2 है। यदि इसके 'n' पदों का योगफल −14 है, तो 'n' ज्ञात कीजिए। प्रथम 20 पदों का योगफल भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: An AP consists of 'n' terms whose nth term is 4 and the common difference is 2. If the sum of 'n' terms of AP is −14, then find 'n'. Also, find the sum of the first 20 terms.

key_points: Sₙ = n/2(a + aₙ) = −14 gives n = 7, a = −8

sub_questions.solution: Let the first term be a and common difference d = 2. Given aₙ = a + (n−1)×2 = 4, so a = 4 − 2(n−1) = 6 − 2n. Sum of n terms: Sₙ = n/2 × (a + aₙ) = n/2 × (6−2n+4) = n/2 × (10−2n) = n(5−n) = −14. So n² − 5n − 14 = 0, giving (n−7)(n+2) = 0. Since n must be positive, n = 7. Then a = 6 − 14 = −8. Sum of first 20 terms: S₂₀ = 20/2 × [2×(−8) + 19×2] = 10 × [−16 + 38] = 10 × 22 = 220.

sub_questions.text: एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी के प्रथम छः पदों का योगफल 42 है। इसके 10वें तथा 30वें पदों का अनुपात 1 : 3 है। समांतर श्रेढ़ी का पहला तथा तेरहवाँ पद परिकलित कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The sum of the first six terms of an arithmetic progression is 42. The ratio of the 10th term to the 30th term is 1 : 3. Calculate the first and the thirteenth terms of the AP.
sub_questions.solution: Let first term = a and common difference = d. S₆ = 6/2 × (2a + 5d) = 3(2a + 5d) = 42, so 2a + 5d = 14 ...(i). Ratio of 10th to 30th term: (a + 9d)/(a + 29d) = 1/3. Cross-multiplying: 3(a + 9d) = a + 29d, giving 3a + 27d = a + 29d, so 2a = 2d, hence a = d ...(ii). Substituting in (i): 2d + 5d = 14, so 7d = 14, d = 2 and a = 2. First term a = 2. Thirteenth term: a₁₃ = a + 12d = 2 + 24 = 26.

questions.solution: This question has two alternatives. See sub-questions (a) and (b) for detailed solutions.

questions.text: एक बर्तन एक उलटे शंकु के आकार का है। इसकी ऊँचाई 8 cm है तथा ऊपर के शिखर, जो खुला है, की त्रिज्या 5 cm है। यह ऊपर तक पानी से भरा है। जब इसमें सीसे की गोलियाँ, जो प्रत्येक 0·5 cm त्रिज्या के गोले के रूप में हैं, डाली गईं, तो बर्तन में पानी का एक-चौथाई भाग पानी बाहर गिर गया। बर्तन में डाली गई सीसे की गोलियों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: A vessel is in the form of an inverted cone. Its height is 8 cm and the radius of its top, which is open, is 5 cm. It is filled with water up to the brim. When lead shots, each of which is a sphere of radius 0·5 cm, are dropped into the vessel, one-fourth of the water flows out. Find the number of lead shots dropped in the vessel.

key_points: Volume of one sphere = (4/3)π×(0.5)³ = π/6 cm³

questions.solution: Volume of the conical vessel = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3) × π × 5² × 8 = 200π/3 cm³. One-fourth of this water flows out, so volume of water displaced = (1/4) × (200π/3) = 50π/3 cm³. Volume of each spherical lead shot = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3) × π × (0.5)³ = (4/3) × π × (1/8) = π/6 cm³. Number of lead shots = Volume displaced / Volume of one shot = (50π/3) ÷ (π/6) = (50π/3) × (6/π) = 100. Therefore, 100 lead shots were dropped into the vessel.

questions.text: एक व्यक्ति ने अपने धन का एक भाग 10% वार्षिक ब्याज पर तथा शेष भाग 15% वार्षिक दर पर उधार दिया। उसे वर्ष के अंत में ₹1,900 की आमदनी हुई। यदि वह अपनी राशियों पर ब्याज की दर पलट देता, तो उसे ₹200 अधिक प्राप्त होते। उसके द्वारा उधार दी गई दोनों राशियाँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: A man lent a part of his money at 10% p.a. and the rest at 15% p.a. His income at the end of the year is ₹1,900. If he had interchanged the rate of interest on the two sums, he would have earned ₹200 more. Find the amount lent in both cases.

key_points: Let amounts be x and y: 0.10x + 0.15y = 1900 and 0.15x + 0.10y = 2100

questions.solution: Let the amount lent at 10% be ₹x and at 15% be ₹y. From given conditions: 10x/100 + 15y/100 = 1900, so 10x + 15y = 190000 ...(i). After interchanging: 15x/100 + 10y/100 = 2100, so 15x + 10y = 210000 ...(ii). Adding (i) and (ii): 25x + 25y = 400000, so x + y = 16000 ...(iii). Subtracting (i) from (ii): 5x − 5y = 20000, so x − y = 4000 ...(iv). From (iii) and (iv): x = 10000, y = 6000. So the amount lent at 10% is ₹10,000 and at 15% is ₹6,000.

questions.text:
(क) दी गई आकृति में, PA, QB तथा RC भुजा AC पर लंबवत हैं। यदि PA = x इकाई, QB = y इकाई तथा RC = z इकाई है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि 1/x + 1/z = 1/y.
अथवा
(ख) एक त्रिभुज ABC की भुजाएँ AB और BC तथा माध्यिका AD एक अन्य त्रिभुज PQR की क्रमशः भुजाओं PQ और QR तथा माध्यिका PM के समानुपाती हैं। दर्शाइए कि △ABC ~ △PQR है।
questions.text_english:
(a) In the given figure, PA, QB and RC are perpendicular to AC. If PA = x units, QB = y units and RC = z units, prove that 1/x + 1/z = 1/y.
OR
(b) Sides AB and BC and median AD of triangle ABC are respectively proportional to sides PQ and QR and median PM of △PQR. Show that △ABC ~ △PQR.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, PA, QB तथा RC भुजा AC पर लंबवत हैं। यदि PA = x इकाई, QB = y इकाई तथा RC = z इकाई है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि 1/x + 1/z = 1/y.
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, PA, QB and RC are perpendicular to AC. If PA = x units, QB = y units and RC = z units, prove that 1/x + 1/z = 1/y.

key_points: In △PAC, QB ∥ PA gives AB/BC = y/x
In △RCA, QB ∥ RC gives AB/BC = (z−y)/z... use similar triangles to get 1/x + 1/z = 1/y

sub_questions.solution: In △APC, QB ∥ PA (both ⊥ AC). By Basic Proportionality Theorem, AB/BC = QB/PA = y/x ...(i). In △ACR, QB ∥ RC (both ⊥ AC). By BPT in △ACR: AB/BC = (RC−QB)/RC... Using similar triangles △QBA ~ △CPA: QB/PA = AB/AC. Similarly in △QBC ~ △RCA: QB/RC = BC/AC. Adding: QB(1/PA + 1/RC) = AB/AC + BC/AC = (AB+BC)/AC = AC/AC = 1. So y(1/x + 1/z) = 1, giving 1/x + 1/z = 1/y. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: एक त्रिभुज ABC की भुजाएँ AB और BC तथा माध्यिका AD एक अन्य त्रिभुज PQR की क्रमशः भुजाओं PQ और QR तथा माध्यिका PM के समानुपाती हैं। दर्शाइए कि △ABC ~ △PQR है।
sub_questions.text_english: Sides AB and BC and median AD of triangle ABC are respectively proportional to sides PQ and QR and median PM of △PQR. Show that △ABC ~ △PQR.

key_points: D is midpoint of BC, M is midpoint of QR
BD = BC/2, QM = QR/2, so AB/PQ = BD/QM = AD/PM

sub_questions.solution: Given AB/PQ = BC/QR = AD/PM. Since D is the midpoint of BC and M is the midpoint of QR, we have BD = BC/2 and QM = QR/2. Therefore AB/PQ = (BC/2)/(QR/2) = BD/QM. So AB/PQ = BD/QM = AD/PM. By SSS similarity, △ABD ~ △PQM. Therefore ∠ABD = ∠PQM, i.e., ∠ABC = ∠PQR. Now in △ABC and △PQR, AB/PQ = BC/QR and ∠ABC = ∠PQR. By SAS similarity criterion, △ABC ~ △PQR. Hence proved.

questions.text:
भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग प्रत्येक वर्ष देश के विभिन्न उप-विभागों में मौसमी और वार्षिक वर्षा का निरीक्षण करता है। इससे उन्हें परिणामों की तुलना और विश्लेषण करने में सहायता मिलती है।

निम्नलिखित सारणी में उप-विभागों में 2023 में मौसमी वर्षा (mm में) दर्शाई गई है।

वर्षा (mm में) | उप-विभागों की संख्या
200 – 400 | 3
400 – 600 | 4
600 – 800 | 7
800 – 1000 | 4
1000 – 1200 | 3
1200 – 1400 | 3
questions.text_english:
The India Meteorological Department observes seasonal and annual rainfall every year in different sub-divisions of our country. It helps them to compare and analyse the results.

The table below shows sub-divisions wise seasonal (monsoon) rainfall (in mm) in 2023.

Rainfall (mm) | No. of Sub-divisions
200 – 400 | 3
400 – 600 | 4
600 – 800 | 7
800 – 1000 | 4
1000 – 1200 | 3
1200 – 1400 | 3
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: बहुलक वर्ग लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the modal class.
sub_questions.solution: The modal class is the class with the highest frequency. From the table, the class 600–800 has the maximum frequency of 7. Therefore the modal class is 600–800.

sub_questions.text: दिए गए आँकड़ों का माध्यक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the median of the given data.
sub_questions.solution: Total sub-divisions n = 3+4+7+4+3+3 = 24. n/2 = 12. Cumulative frequencies: up to 400 = 3, up to 600 = 7, up to 800 = 14. Since 12 lies between 7 and 14, the median class is 600–800. l = 600, cf = 7, f = 7, h = 200. Median = 600 + ((12−7)/7) × 200 = 600 + (5/7) × 200 = 600 + 142.86 ≈ 742.86 mm.

sub_questions.text: इस मौसम में वर्षा का माध्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the mean rainfall in the season.

sub_questions.text: यदि वर्षा के मौसम के दौरान कम-से-कम 800 mm वर्षा वाले उप-विभाग को अच्छी वर्षा वाला उप-विभाग माना जाता है, तो कितने उप-विभागों में अच्छी वर्षा हुई?
sub_questions.text_english: If a sub-division having at least 800 mm rainfall during monsoon season is considered a good rainfall sub-division, then how many sub-divisions had good rainfall?
sub_questions.solution: Sub-divisions with at least 800 mm rainfall are those in classes 800–1000, 1000–1200, and 1200–1400. Their frequencies are 4, 3, and 3 respectively. Total = 4 + 3 + 3 = 10. So 10 sub-divisions had good rainfall.

questions.text:
एक उद्यान डिजाइनर एक आयताकार लॉन की योजना बना रहा है, जिसके चारों ओर एकसमान रास्ता बनाया जाना है।

लॉन और रास्ते का कुल क्षेत्रफल 360 वर्ग मीटर है। रास्ते की चौड़ाई हर तरफ से समान है। लॉन की विमाएँ 12 मीटर × 10 मीटर हैं।
questions.text_english:
A garden designer is planning a rectangular lawn that is to be surrounded by a uniform walkway.

The total area of the lawn and the walkway is 360 square metres. The width of the walkway is same on all sides. The dimensions of the lawn itself are 12 metres by 10 metres.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: रास्ते की चौड़ाई को x मीटर लेकर लॉन तथा रास्ते के कुल क्षेत्रफल को निरूपित करने वाला द्विघात समीकरण बनाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Formulate the quadratic equation representing the total area of the lawn and the walkway, taking width of walkway = x m.
sub_questions.solution: With walkway of width x m on all sides, total length = 12+2x and total width = 10+2x. Total area = (12+2x)(10+2x) = 360. Expanding: 120 + 24x + 20x + 4x² = 360, so 4x² + 44x + 120 = 360, giving 4x² + 44x − 240 = 0, or x² + 11x − 60 = 0. This is the required quadratic equation.

sub_questions.text: रास्ते की चौड़ाई 'x' ज्ञात करने के लिए द्विघात समीकरण हल कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Solve the quadratic equation to find the width of the walkway 'x'.
sub_questions.solution: Solving x² + 11x − 60 = 0 by factorisation: x² + 15x − 4x − 60 = 0, giving x(x+15) − 4(x+15) = 0, so (x−4)(x+15) = 0. Therefore x = 4 or x = −15. Since width cannot be negative, x = 4 m. The width of the walkway is 4 metres.

sub_questions.text: यदि रास्ते पर टाइलें लगाने का खर्च ₹50 प्रति वर्ग मीटर की दर से ₹12,000 आता है, तो रास्ते का क्षेत्रफल परिकलित कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If the cost of paving the walkway at the rate of ₹50 per square metre is ₹12,000, calculate the area of the walkway.
sub_questions.solution: Area of walkway = Total cost / Cost per square metre = 12000 / 50 = 240 m². Therefore the area of the walkway is 240 square metres.

sub_questions.text: लॉन का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the perimeter of the lawn.
sub_questions.solution: The dimensions of the lawn are 12 m × 10 m. Perimeter of the lawn = 2 × (length + breadth) = 2 × (12 + 10) = 2 × 22 = 44 metres.

questions.text: समुद्र के किनारे एक चट्टान पर एक लाइटहाउस खड़ा है, जो पास से गुजरने वाले जहाजों पर नज़र रखता है। एक दिन लाइटहाउस के शिखर से एक जहाज को किनारे की ओर आते देखने पर पाया कि जैसे ही यह बिंदु P से Q की तरफ आता है, तो इसका अवनमन कोण 30° से 45° में बदल जाता है। लाइटहाउस की ऊँचाई 50 मीटर है।
questions.text_english: A lighthouse stands tall on a cliff by the sea, watching over ships that pass by. One day a ship is seen approaching the shore and from the top of the lighthouse, the angles of depression of the ship are observed to be 30° and 45° as it moves from point P to point Q. The height of the lighthouse is 50 metres.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the information given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: जहाज जब बिंदु Q पर है तो इसकी लाइटहाउस के आधार से दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए, जबकि यहाँ का अवनमन कोण 45° है।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance of the ship from the base of the lighthouse when it is at point Q, where the angle of depression is 45°.
sub_questions.solution: Let A be the base of the lighthouse. When the ship is at Q, the angle of depression is 45°. So tan 45° = height / distance = 50 / QA. Since tan 45° = 1, QA = 50 m. The ship is 50 metres from the base of the lighthouse.

sub_questions.text: ∠PBA तथा ∠QBA की माप ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the measures of ∠PBA and ∠QBA.
sub_questions.solution: B is the top of the lighthouse. The angle of depression from B to P is 30°, so ∠PBA = 30° (alternate interior angles between parallel horizontal and the line of sight). Similarly, the angle of depression from B to Q is 45°, so ∠QBA = 45°.

sub_questions.text: जहाज द्वारा बिंदु P से Q तक तय की गई दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance travelled by the ship between points P and Q.
sub_questions.solution: Let A be the base of the lighthouse (on ground). QA = 50 m (from part i). For point P, angle of depression = 30°: tan 30° = 50/PA, so PA = 50/tan30° = 50√3 m. Distance PQ = PA − QA = 50√3 − 50 = 50(√3 − 1) metres.

sub_questions.text: यदि यह जहाज किनारे की ओर चलता रहे तथा Q से A तक आने में 10 मिनट ले, तो इसकी गति Q से A तक km/h में परिकलित कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If the ship continues moving towards the shore and takes 10 minutes to travel from Q to A, calculate the speed of the ship in km/h, from Q to A.
sub_questions.solution: Distance from Q to A = 50 m = 50/1000 km = 0.05 km. Time taken = 10 minutes = 10/60 hour = 1/6 hour. Speed = Distance / Time = 0.05 ÷ (1/6) = 0.05 × 6 = 0.3 km/h. Therefore the speed of the ship from Q to A is 0.3 km/h.
